coachLines: You don't have to do anything else right now. Just stay here and breathe.
This is near the top of it. Cravings climb fast and then they stop climbing.
Notice it without arguing with it. You're not trying to win, you're waiting it out.
It's already smaller than it was a minute ago, even if it doesn't feel finished.
Almost through. Whatever's left of it is on its way out.

healthBenefits.detail: Alcohol metabolism varies with the amount consumed and individual factors. A timer cannot tell you when alcohol has cleared or when it is safe to drive.
healthBenefits.title: Alcohol metabolism

healthBenefits.detail: Alcohol can affect blood sugar regulation. Changes after stopping differ between people; this app does not measure your blood sugar or insulin response.
healthBenefits.summary: Learn about alcohol and blood sugar.
healthBenefits.title: Blood sugar context

healthBenefits.detail: Alcohol can affect hydration. Your day count is not a hydration measurement or a prediction of when symptoms will change.
healthBenefits.title: Hydration

healthBenefits.detail: Alcohol can affect sleep. Some people notice changes after stopping, but the timing and experience vary. This milestone does not measure sleep or promise a recovery date.
healthBenefits.title: Sleep and alcohol

healthBenefits.detail: People may notice changes in concentration after reducing or stopping alcohol. Individual experiences vary; this app does not assess cognitive function.
healthBenefits.title: Mental clarity

healthBenefits.detail: Alcohol and anxiety can interact in different ways. This app does not assess or treat anxiety. Speak with a qualified clinician about symptoms or concerns.
healthBenefits.title: Anxiety and alcohol

healthBenefits.detail: Research describes links between alcohol use and liver health. Your elapsed time does not establish a change in liver fat or blood tests. Discuss your health with a clinician.
healthBenefits.summary: Learn about alcohol and the liver.
healthBenefits.title: Liver health

healthBenefits.detail: The app's calorie totals use the amount you entered. They do not predict weight change, measure body fat, or account for changes in food intake.
healthBenefits.summary: Understand the calories in your routine.
healthBenefits.title: Alcohol calories

healthBenefits.detail: Alcohol use can affect blood pressure, but responses and timing vary. This app does not measure blood pressure or predict when it will change.
healthBenefits.summary: Learn about alcohol and heart health.
healthBenefits.title: Blood pressure information

healthBenefits.detail: Alcohol use and heart health are linked in research. Your counter is not a measurement of resting heart rate, arterial function, or cardiovascular recovery.
healthBenefits.title: Heart health information

healthBenefits.detail: Around six months, take stock of the routines and personal progress that brought you here.
healthBenefits.title: Six-Month Milestone

healthBenefits.detail: Alcohol can affect hydration and skin. Changes vary between people; this milestone does not establish when a visible or medical change will occur.
healthBenefits.summary: Notice changes without a promised timeline.
healthBenefits.title: Skin and hydration

healthBenefits.detail: A year is a meaningful progress marker, not a declaration of full recovery. Discuss your individual health and risks with a qualified clinician.
healthBenefits.title: One-Year Milestone

journalPrompts.text: How has my daily life changed since I stopped drinking?
What's one thing I'm grateful for today?
Where did I feel strongest today?
What triggers came up today, and how did I respond?
Describe a moment of peace I experienced recently.
What's going well today? How can I keep this momentum?
If I had a drink today, what would I lose?
Who supported me today, even in a small way?
What did my body thank me for today?
What am I looking forward to this week?
Name a situation that used to involve drinking. How did I navigate it?
What's one healthy habit I'd like to build next?
How is my sleep different now?
What did I do today that my future self will thank me for?
Where do I notice cravings hide?
What does sobriety give me that drinking never could?
Describe a small win from today.
What's a relationship that's improving since I quit?
What would a 'reset' actually cost me, in days and dollars?
Three words to describe how I feel right now.

species.description: A timeless upright bonsai. Symmetrical, balanced, serene.
The cascade style mimics a tree growing on a cliff, plunging downward.
A flowering sakura wrapped in soft pink bloom. Petals drift down as your streak grows.
A lacy maple in warm autumn red and gold. Star-shaped leaves drift down as the days add up.
An evergreen pine with cloud-like needle tiers and a gnarled, weathered trunk.
Shaped by a lifetime of wind. Every branch tells a story of endurance.
